snippet.title: Star Ash Fleet - Final Trailer
snippet.description:
Please visit the Steam Store page and Add to Wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310330?utm_source=YouTube

In "Star Ash Fleet", players will take on the role of a fleet commander in a future interstellar war. Edit your fleet within limited choices and control them on a rapidly changing battlefield. Each battle is like a game of chess, where every ship is a piece to be utilized wisely to achieve victory.
